title: Your First Rocket — Earth to Orbit
realism_note: Earth gravity, mass loss and thrust are simulated with a simplified one-axis pitch profile; orbital insertion is guided and time-compressed, not a numerical orbit solver.

objectives.text: Tap LAUNCH to lift off. Fuel, height and speed will start changing.
When the first fuel tank is empty, tap SEPARATE STAGE.
Keep climbing until GUIDED ORBIT lights up, then tap it.
